tr.description:
JOIN THE BATTLE!
Play Axis & Allies 1942 Online on your iPad! It’s the official digital version of Hasbro’s classic board game, Axis & Allies 1942 Second Edition. Strategy is key as you command armies across the globe!

*Note: Apple Accounts held by users aged 12 and under will not be able to access our online multiplayer features.

Team up with friends across platforms, get competitive in ranked seasons, play solo against the A.I., or pass & play with a pal on one tablet!

FEATURES

Official Rules 
- Adapts rules from Hasbro’s Axis & Allies 1942 Second Edition
- Choose from two game scenarios & victory conditions!
- Allies: Command your forces as the United Kingdom, United States, or Soviet Union
- Axis: Take control of Germany or Japan’s armies & prepare for battle!

Learn to Play 
- Great for new players— no setup or cleanup required!
- Tutorials & In-Game Tooltips help beginners dive in

Turn-Based (Asynchronous) 
- Fully turn-based gameplay fits into your busy schedule! 
- Ranked games allow 24 hours to take your turn
- Instead of playing for hours on end, get notified when it’s your turn, then use the War Diary to check out what you missed! (or stick around & watch the battle unfold in real time— that’s an option too!)

Player Accounts & Profiles
- Track your stats & win/loss rates for each alliance
- Your commander account syncs across devices
- Switch seamlessly between iPad & desktop to take your turns, view your stats & connect with friends

Dice Modes
- Standard mode mimics random dice results
- Low Luck dice use averages to calculate hits
- Biased dice favor rolls of 2, 3, & 4, over 1 & 6

Immersive Gameplay
- High quality graphics, music & sound effects add drama to your battles!

GAME MODES

Single-Player
- Enjoy casual games with A.I. computer players
- Great for learning to play or testing out strategies

Hot Seat
- Pass the tablet around to play with friends & family

Online Multiplayer
- Cross-platform play between tablets & computers
- Create custom games for 2 to 5 players
- Games can include a mix of humans & A.I. players

Ranked Seasons
- Challenge the world’s top Axis & Allies players in official ranked seasons
- Rise through the ranks to take top honors: Wood, Bronze, Silver, Gold & Platinum Tiers!
- Matchmaking pairs you with similarly ranked players

SPRING 1942...THE WORLD IS AT WAR
German tanks mobilize in the west, blitzing into France and pushing back the Soviet Union in eastern Europe. The United States rises in response to Japanese aggression in the Pacific. The United Kingdom rallies allies as bombers menace the skies. The year is 1942, and the world is at war! 

Victory goes to the side that conquers its opponents on the field of battle and occupies the greatest cities of the world. Will the Axis continue to spread across the globe unchecked, or will the Allies rally to push back against imperialistic tyranny? Challenge your friends and change the course of history!

tr.description:
Where you're born decides more about your life than almost anything you'll ever choose. 1in8b Life lets you feel that.

Press "Be born" and a point skips across the world map until it settles on one place: a city in Nigeria, a village in India, an apartment in Seoul, a farm in Bolivia. The odds are real. Countries with more babies come up more often, just as they do in life.

Then you live. Year by year, from your first word to your last breath.

A WHOLE LIFE, IN REAL NUMBERS
Your chances of surviving childhood, going to school, finding work, earning a living and growing old come from real data for 172 countries and territories. That data covers life expectancy, child mortality, income and inequality, schooling, fertility, health costs, conflict, natural hazards and more.

YOUR CHOICES STILL MATTER
Each year you decide where to spend your free time: study, career, family, health, faith, rest. You'll face hundreds of decisions: stay in school or help your family, move to the city, marry, have children, buy a home, invest, lend a friend money, flee a war, fight an illness. Every option shows its cost, its chances and its trade-offs. Effort counts, but circumstance pushes back.

THE PEOPLE AROUND YOU
Parents with names and jobs, brothers and sisters, a spouse, children and grandchildren, friends, pets. They grow up, grow old, move away and pass on. Your identity card, family panel and wealth breakdown show your whole life at a glance.

BORN IN THE SAME SECOND
Three other babies are born at the very moment you are, somewhere else in the world. Their lives unfold by the same rules. You'll hear how they go.

A LIFE RECORD TO KEEP
When your life ends, you get its full story: the turning points, the people, the numbers, how you compared with the rest of the world. Every life becomes a star in your sky of past lives. Share any of them as an image.

FEATURES
• 172 countries and territories, weighted by real birth rates
• Hundreds of events and decisions, with real odds shown
• Careers, school, marriage, children, migration, illness, war, recessions and inflation
• A pixel-art scene of your home and family that changes as you age
• Pauses at 5, 18, 30, 50 and 70 to reflect, and write down your thoughts
• Works offline. No account, no sign-up; your lives stay on your device

These lives are simulations, not predictions. They show the odds people face, not anyone's fate. Each one is a reminder of how much of a life is decided before it begins.


Where will you be born?

tr.description:
Digline is a relaxed and easy to learn drilling game where every descent is a gamble between progress and risk, and the real reward lies deeper underground.

Start each run in your workshop, pick your setup, and head down with limited fuel and a scrappy rig. Carve your path through shifting layers of earth, decide what to collect, and choose what to upgrade and what to trade before everything runs out.

Each dive reveals new materials, rarer finds, and unexpected patterns beneath the surface. What begins as simple digging gradually turns into a careful balance between exploration, efficiency, and timing.

Back at the surface, refine your strategy and improve your runs:

• Upgrade your drill, fuel capacity, and efficiency
• Unlock new materials with higher value and deeper placement
• Optimise routes to maximise each descent

Progress builds steadily, but every run carries tension. Go too safe and you leave value behind. Push too far and risk losing it all.

Shape your own rhythm underground: short and efficient runs, deep high-risk dives, or a steady climb towards mastering what lies below.

Top 10 casual game in the UK and US, Top 5 in Germany, Norway, and others. Come join the fun!

What starts as a simple search for resources gradually becomes something stranger. Your old tunnels remain, your map expands over time, and the underground begins to feel less random and more like a place with its own history.

Digline is designed to be easy to pick up, fun in short sessions, and rewarding over the long term. Quick digs, short descents, tons of relaxing fun.

Features:

• intuitive one-finger portrait controls
• short runs that fit easily into a minute or two
• persistent tunnels and a map that grows with each expedition
• multiple underground regions with different materials, hazards, and surprises
• resources to gather and use for crafting upgrades, and better preparation
• a workshop that turns each successful run into permanent progress
• a market system for trading what you bring back
• progression that builds across many sessions, not just a single run
• a calm, cosy atmosphere with a sense of discovery underneath it
• no ads, no in-app purchases, and no pay-to-win systems
• achievements and Daily Dig leaderboard competition

The deeper you go, the more the mine will reveal.

tr.description:
The car at the door has its front end caved in. It's sitting right there between you.
"Car has no damage," he says.

Nobody in this trade tells the truth. In a minute.

Haggling
"One owner from new." "Original color, never repainted." "Had it for years, my pride and joy."
If it's his pride and joy, why is he selling it. Not your problem. Your problem is the registration and the inspection report in your hand. If the registration lists three owners, "one owner from new" falls apart on the table and the price comes down with it. Accuse him with nothing in your hand and he tightens up, and so does the price. Nobody tells you the lowest they'll go; you read it in how they give ground. Some of them just get up and leave.

The workshop
You beat the dents out with a hammer, paint the car with your finger, fit rims and a spoiler. What goes in as scrap comes out onto the floor gleaming. The next day a buyer walks in, you say "gently used," and you don't blink.

Auction day
The day opens in the auction hall. You bid against rival dealers. You can go in blind on a lot nobody has opened: sometimes it's a classic, sometimes it's a lesson.

End of day
The ledger closes. Did you turn a profit today, or did you just move cars around? The numbers will tell you.

You're the hunter when you buy. When you sell, you're not.

A remodeled 2D take on the fourth game in the world-renowned FINAL FANTASY series! Enjoy the timeless story told through charming retro graphics. All the magic of the original, with improved ease of play.

The Kingdom of Baron sent their elite airship fleet, the Red Wings, to attack the surrounding countries. Distressed by his mission, Cecil, a dark knight and captain of the Red Wings, decides to fight against the tyrannical Baron with his trusted friend and his paramour at his side. In his search for the crystals, Cecil must travel over land, under the ground, to the Land of Summons, and even to the moon. Join forces with Kain the dragoon, Rosa the white mage, Rydia the summoner, and many more skilled allies.

FFIV is the first title to introduce the dynamic "Active Time Battle" system, where time moves even during battle, giving the players an exciting sense of urgency.Thanks to the wide appeal of the game, this revolutionary system would be implemented in many future titles in the series.

Witness the dramatic story and dynamic battles in this fourth installment of the FINAL FANTASY series!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

■ Beautifully revived with new graphics and sound!
・Universally updated 2D pixel graphics, including the iconic FINAL FANTASY character pixel designs created by Kazuko Shibuya, the original artist and current collaborator.
・Beautifully rearranged soundtrack in a faithful FINAL FANTASY style, overseen by original composer Nobuo Uematsu.

■Improved gameplay!
・Including modernized UI, auto-battle options, and more.
・Also supports game pad controls, making it possible to play using a dedicated gamepad UI when connecting a gamepad to your device.
・Switch the soundtrack between the rearranged version, created for the pixel remaster, or the original version, capturing the sound of the original game.
・Now possible to switch between different fonts, including the default font and a pixel-based font based on the atmosphere of the original game.
・Additional boost features to expand gameplay options, including switching off random encounters and adjusting experience gained multipliers between 0 and 4.
・Dive into the world of the game with supplemental extras like the bestiary, illustration gallery, and music player.

*One-time purchase. The app will not require any additional payments to play through the game after the initial purchase and subsequent download.

Outline

The smash hit RPG: Final Fantasy VII, which has sold over 11,000,000 units* worldwide, finally arrives on iOS!

The first Final Fantasy to feature 3D backgrounds and CG movie scenes, this dramatic tale continues to be loved by numerous fans around the world. Battle stages also appear in full 3D for the first time, bringing an even greater sense of awe and spectacle to combat!

Customize your characters in any way you like using the fantastic “material” system that allows endless combinations of spells and abilities.

Story

With its unshakeable monopoly over Mako energy production, the evil Shinra Electric Power Company holds tight to the reigns of world power.
One day, a Mako reactor serving the sprawling metropolis of Midgar is attacked and destroyed in a bombing raid by a revolutionary group calling themselves Avalanche. 
Cloud Strife, a former member of Shinra’s elite “Soldier” unit takes part in the raid as a mercenary hired by Avalanche and sets events in motion that will draw him and his friends into an epic struggle for the fate of the planet itself…

Menu navigation: Fixed digital buttons

The King of Tycoon has sensed a disturbance in the wind. When the crystals that balance the powers of the world are threatened, the king hastens to the rescue...only to go missing. Somewhere a young man and his Chocobo find themselves drawn toward friends that will change their destiny.

Building on the job systems of previous games, FFV includes a diverse selection of jobs to try, and a unique ability system that lets you combine skills.

Develop your characters with free reign, and master your battle tactics in the fifth installment of the FINAL FANTASY series!

----------------------------------------------------------------------

■ Beautifully revived with new graphics and sound!
・Universally updated 2D pixel graphics, including the iconic FINAL FANTASY character pixel designs created by Kazuko Shibuya, the original artist and current collaborator.
・Beautifully rearranged soundtrack in a faithful FINAL FANTASY style, overseen by original composer Nobuo Uematsu.

■Improved gameplay!
・Including modernized UI, auto-battle options, and more.
・Also supports game pad controls, making it possible to play using a dedicated gamepad UI when connecting a gamepad to your device.
・Switch the soundtrack between the rearranged version, created for the pixel remaster, or the original version, capturing the sound of the original game.
・Now possible to switch between different fonts, including the default font and a pixel-based font based on the atmosphere of the original game.
・Additional boost features to expand gameplay options, including switching off random encounters and adjusting experience gained multipliers between 0 and 4.
・Dive into the world of the game with supplemental extras like the bestiary, illustration gallery, and music player.

*One-time purchase. The app will not require any additional payments to play through the game after the initial purchase and subsequent download.
*This remaster is based on the original "FINAL FANTASY V" game released in 1992. Features and/or content may differ from previously rereleased versions of the game.

[OS Compatibility]
iOS 13.0 or higher

[Applicable Devices]

iPhone 7 Plus, iPad (7th generation), iPad Air (3rd generation), iPad mini (5th generation) and higher

Selling over 5.5million copies since its release in 2000, FINAL FANTASY IX proudly returns on iOS! 
Now you can relive the adventures of Zidane and his crew in the palm of your hands!

Enjoy this classic FINAL FANTASY experience with no additional fees or purchases.


■Story
Zidane and the Tantalus Theater Troupe have kidnapped Princess Garnet, the heir of Alexandria. 
To their surprise, however, the princess herself yearned to escape the castle. 
Through a series of unusual circumstances, she and her personal guard, Steiner, fall in with Zidane and set out on an incredible journey. 
Meeting unforgettable characters like Vivi and Quina along the way, they learn about themselves, the secrets of the Crystal, and a malevolent force that threatens to destroy their world.


■Gameplay Features

・Abilities
Learn new abilities by equipping items. 
When fully mastered, these abilities can be used even without equipping items, allowing for nearly endless customization options.

・Trance
Fill your Trance gauge as you sustain hits in battle. 
When fully charged, your characters will enter Trance mode, granting them powerful new skills!

・Synthesis
Never let items go to waste. Combine two items or pieces of equipment together and make better, stronger items!

・Minigames
Whether it's Chocobo Hot and Cold, Jump Rope, or Tetra Master, there are plenty of minigames to enjoy when you're not off saving the world. 
You can even earn special item rewards!

tr.description:
Final Fantasy III -- now on iPhone!

When darkness falls and the land is robbed of light, four youths are chosen by the crystals to embark upon a journey to save the world.

FINAL FANTASY III was the first title in the FINAL FANTASY series to become a million-seller, establishing once and for all that Square Enix's classic RPG saga was here to stay.

A hallmark of innovation for the entire series, FINAL FANTASY III incorporates not only a job system that lets characters change classes at any time to the ability to summon powerful creatures such as Shiva and Bahamut.

The 3D remake of FINAL FANTASY III, with fully-rendered 3D graphics, duplicated the original's success.

- The four protagonists have been completely redesigned and new scenarios have been added.

- The 3D remake has really brought the cutscenes and battles to life.

- The Job system has been improved to bring out its best and most unique aspects, resulting in a more balanced game that is easy to enjoy.

- New save functions, including autosave, allow for players to quit the game at any time without fear of losing their progress.

--------------------------------------------

Aditionally, the smartphone version has been improved to include the following:

- High resolution graphics and retouched cutscenes.

- Smooth, intuitive touch-panel controls specifically tailored to improve the gaming experience.

- Gallery Mode, where players can view  illustrations from the game  or listen to the soundtrack, has been added.

- New visual designs for the Job Mastery Cards and the Mognet .

* Entering or leaving vehicles such as cars and the Garden may occasionally get your character stuck between the vehicle and terrain features, or freeze the vehicle in place. This seems to happen more often when you leave your vehicle in close proximity to impassable terrain, or when you try to enter or leave your vehicle during certain scripted events. Currently, the only fix for this is to reload a previously saved game, so please make sure to save your progress often.

* Some locations may be difficult to navigate using the Speed Boost (x3). We advise you to turn off this feature in such cases.

* Make sure to check the FAQ section of our support page for solutions to common issues:
https://support.na.square-enix.com/main.php?la=1&id=442

We apologize for any inconvenience these issues may cause, and thank you again for your interest in our product.

■Summary
FINAL FANTASY VIII was first released on February 11, 1999. Beloved by fans, this title has garnered a great deal of popularity even compared to other installments in the FINAL FANTASY franchise, selling more than 9.6 million units worldwide. And now players can enjoy FINAL FANTASY VIII on their smartphone! With renewed character CG, the world of FINAL FANTASY VIII is now more beautiful than ever before.

This installment is a remaster of FINAL FANTASY VIII for PC. This application is a one-time purchase. There will be no additional charge incurred after downloading.

■Story
It is a time of war.
The Republic of Galbadia, under the influence of the sorceress Edea, mobilizes its great armies against the other nations of the world.
Squall and other members of SeeD, an elite mercenary force, join hands with Rinoa, a resistance fighter, to fight against Galbadia's tyrannical rule and to prevent Edea from fulfilling her ultimate goal.

■FINAL FANTASY VIII: Release Features
・Guardian Force（G.F.）
G.F. are summoned creatures in FFVIII used to protect the protagonists. Call upon them in battle to unleash their might and to increase their power alongside player characters. By junctioning G.F., players will be able to enjoy greater freedom in how they approach battles.

・Drawing
Obtain magic in FFVIII by drawing (extracting) it in battle. MP does not exist and players are limited to the number they have in their possession. Magic that has been extracted can be released on the spot or stocked for later use.

・ Junctioning
This system allows players to equip G.F. and stocked magic to characters in order to increase their power.

■ Additional Features
・ Battle Assist
Max out HP and ATB gauge during battle and activate Limit Breaks at any time.
・ No Encounters
Players can choose to turn Battle Encounters on or off.
・ 3x Speed
With the exception of certain cutscenes, players can choose to proceed through the game at 3x speed.


[Minimum Requirements]
iOS 15.0 or higher

tr.description:
Doğduğun gün ilk evrak masaya düşer: nüfus kaydı. Onaylarsın. Sonra karne, sınav, ilk iş, ilk kira, ilk aşk, ilk ret mektubu.

Bu oyunda hayatının her kararı bir evrak olarak gelir. Okursun, damganı basarsın: ONAY ya da RED. O kadar.

Ama bir sorun var. Gitmek istiyorsun ve konsolosluk her şeye bakıyor: banka hesabına, işine, evine, ailene, seyahat geçmişine. Gidebilmek için önce burada bir hayat kurduğunu kanıtlaman lazım.

NE YAPARSIN
• Okursun, çalışırsın, terfi alırsın ya da kovulursun. Garsonluktan kafe ortaklığına, stajyerlikten CTO'luğa.
• Aile evinden yurda, rutubetli 1+1'den kendi evine taşınırsın. Ev sahibi Necdet Bey kirayı her yıl artırır.
• Aşık olursun, evlenirsin, çocukların olur. Annen arar. Kuzen Emre Amsterdam'dan kartpostal atar.
• Enflasyonla yarışırsın. Euro alırsın. Bir gün paradan üç sıfır atılır.
• Vize randevusu alırsın. Sıra numaran ekranda yanar, memur dosyanı satır satır inceler, onay ihtimalin ekrana gelir. Damga iner.

VİZE MERDİVENİ
1 Gün, 1 Hafta, 1 Ay, 3 Ay, 1 Yıl, 5 Yıl, 10 Yıl, 100 Yıl ve en sonunda SONSUZ. Her onayla bir şehre gidersin: Selanik'ten Tokyo'ya, Reykjavik'ten Mars Kolonisi'ne. Pasaportun damgalarla dolar.

HAYAT DEVAM EDER
Bir gün hayatın biter. Dosya kapanmaz. Çocuğun ya da yeğenin mirasla birlikte aynı masaya oturur. Aile sicilin konsoloslukta hatırlanır. Yıllar 2026'dan 2100'lere akar; bürokrasi hiç ölmez.

• Piksel sanat: vesikalığın yaşla değişir, saçın ağarır, çocukların sana benzer.
• Yüzlerce olay ve onlarca hikâye. Her hayat başka.
• Günün Postası, rozetler, fotoğraf albümü, pasaport koleksiyonu, soy ağacı.
• İnternetsiz oynanır. Tek kişiliktir.
• Bir kez alırsın, hepsi senin. Reklam yok, uygulama içi satın alma yok.

Oyundaki kurumlar, memurlar, konsolosluklar ve kişiler hayal ürünüdür. Vize: Yaşam Simülasyonu hiçbir resmî kurumla bağlantılı değildir ve gerçek vize başvurusu yapmaz. Oyun dili Türkçedir.

tr.description:
般若心灯是一款佛教经典导读、念佛计数与佛乐聆听应用，帮助您随时随地诵读经文、聆听梵音、记录功课，在日常中安住身心、亲近佛法。

    【经书收录】
    收录心经、金刚经、普门品、药师经、普光明藏经、阿弥陀经、法华经、六祖坛经、楞严经、地藏经等经典，大悲咒、楞严咒、准提咒、百字明咒、往生咒、绿度母心咒等咒语真言，以及大忏悔文、回向文、课诵仪轨、药师经仪轨、地藏经
  前仪等课诵内容，共二十四部经典与仪轨，持续更新中。

    【课诵仪轨】
    香赞、净口业与净三业真言、安土地真言、普供养真言、开经偈为前行，补阙真言、普回向真言、三皈依为结行，诵持任一经典皆可依用；另立药师专篇，收药师赞、药师偈与药师灌顶真言。

    【逐字拼音】
    每一个汉字上方都标注了准确的拼音，方便初学者正确诵读经文，不再因生僻字而困扰。

    【白话文解释】
    关键经文配有通俗易懂的白话文解释，轻触即可查看，帮助您深入理解经文含义。

    【经文朗读】
    部分经典内置音频朗读，支持进度拖动、0.25x 至 2.0x 变速播放，以及后台与锁屏播放；未配音的经典仍可使用逐字拼音安心诵读。

    【歌词式阅读指示】
    阅读经文时，屏幕中央显示虚线定位指示器与当前行号，当前行高亮、远处渐淡，方便随时找回诵读位置。

    【佛乐聆听】
    精选 34 首佛教音乐，涵盖大悲咒、密咒真言、凡歌咏法、一心念佛等八大分类，支持播放列表、上下曲切换、进度拖动与变速播放，后台锁屏亦可聆听。可设 10 至 90 分钟定时关闭或「播完本曲」，到点前音量渐渐淡出，不会突然静下
  来。

    【佛珠念佛】
    轻触或沿珠串滑动即可拨珠计数，每颗都有木珠相碰的音效与触感反馈，108 颗圆满一圈。本次声数叠在佛珠环心，今日与本圈进度并列其下；长按佛珠可按本次、今日、累计分别归零。圣号可下拉切换或自行添加，拨珠音色可选佛珠或木
  鱼，振动强度分轻、中、强三档。自动记录今日声数与念佛时长，可一键生成水墨风格卡片分享今日修持。

    【自定义功课】
    可新建功课，设定名称、圣号、总目标与目标天数，每天该念多少自动算出。念佛页显示目标进度、剩余声数与今日完成情况，每份功课可单独设定回向文，发愿时自动填入；达成每日目标或圆满总目标时给出提示。

    【佛历】
    二十七个佛菩萨圣诞与初一、十五集中一页，按农历月分组，农历与公历对照，只列当年剩余的日子。可开启提醒，于前一日傍晚收到通知，斋日提醒可单独开关。

    【修行打卡】
    每日打卡记录修行，日历视图直观展示诵经轨迹，连续天数激励您坚持修行。偶尔忘记打卡也无妨，支持补打最近数日的功课，连续天数自动接上。

    【功德牌与足迹】
    诵读、打卡、念佛皆可累积功德牌，涵盖单经精进、广学多闻、持之以恒、念佛功课与佛菩萨圣诞时节。轻触日历上的打卡点，可回看那一天诵读过哪些经书，并为当日功课写下心愿。

    【发愿回向】
    念佛之后可写下愿文与回向，一日多愿亦可分别留档。所有发愿按时间成串收在「发愿记录」中，可随时修改或删除，日后回看重温初心。

    【修行回顾】
    按年汇总修行天数、最长连续与常诵经典，生成水墨风格回顾卡片，可保存分享。

    【iCloud 同步】
    开启后，打卡记录、功德牌、诵经进度、自定义功课与圣号在您的各台设备间保持一致，无需额外费用。

    【个性设置】
    支持夜间模式，经文字号自由调节，打造舒适的阅读体验。

    【收藏与进度】
    收藏常读经书，自动记录阅读进度，每次打开都能继续上次的修行。

    般若心灯，愿以智慧之光，照亮您的修行之路。

    【随喜护持】
    佛经、佛咒与仪轨全部免费诵读。念佛计数、佛乐聆听与离线下载、修行记录与打卡、自定义背景与佛像、经文听诵、自定义功课、年度回顾为护持功能，可选月度护持、年度护持（自动续订，可随时在 Apple ID 设置中取消）或终身护持（一次性购买）。付费下载时期已购买的用户自动视为终身护持。

tr.description:
AI 時代還要學程式設計嗎？事實是要，但已經不是過去的學習方式，怎麼說呢？以前的老前輩總是要學初學者先掌握一門程式語言，這裡所謂的掌握，拿 C 語言來舉例，就是要到能開發出 C 語言編譯器甚至到用 C 語言寫出作業系統，所以程式設計專科像是資訊工程系的課程就是這樣安排。

換句話說，過去的觀念強調用背誦培養，不管學生懂不懂，反正學生不懂也是可以先背起來，很多前輩的求學歷程不外都是先背了一堆知識，等到了未來某一天見到了某個知識點，才總算觸類旁通，以前不懂的，才在突然懂了，也就是到了特定知識點才對程式設計開竅。

先記住等到以後才弄懂的模式，坦白說是要在戰後快速培養人才，這樣記性好、學習效率高，也就是遴選出智商高的人才，問題是記性不等於悟性，所以記住是記住，卻不等於理解到懂的程度。

這就導致一種很詭異的現象，智商高的人記住了但是不懂，結果就是一直耍小聰明，賣弄他記住的知識，卻難以真正做創造或發明的工作，其實現在的 AI 幾乎可以說是就是智商極高的智能體， AI 可以依據提示詞做推論，但也僅只於推論而已，正確與否或是否符合需求則需要由另一套機制驗證。

所以 AI 強在可以跟你講知識，依據你輸入的文字推論你想要的結果，但目前的 AI 無法體察你言語間細微的變化，也無法分辨你言語的意思是否是 AI 能夠理解的意思，換句話說沒辦法察言觀色，也就是 AI 理解不了你懂或是不懂，或是你的理解與 AI 的理解是否相同，結果是你讓智商高的 AI 一直賣弄小聰明，向你堆知識，瞬間給你座圖書館，這就引出真正的難題，你不懂就不會用，你能做的頂多是跟 AI 一樣，依樣畫葫蘆，如果你不想畫一樣的葫蘆，你還是得懂。

正因為是弄懂了才會用，從另一種角度來講，懂了才知道要去記什麼，從而長出記性，多年的教學經驗給我的感受是讓多數學習程式設計的人，恍然大悟的知識點是弄懂產品的概念，換言之，從前是先學什麼是程式，從程式慢慢擴張到軟體，再從軟體的角度去學開發產品，這時候軟體規格到整個軟體的架構才出來，然後才懂得程式只是零件，所以說到頭，軟體開發是有了基本的邏輯概念後，去寫構成零件的程式，然後才能去組合零件到產品。

所以本 App 的設計理念反其道而行，從產品的角度出發，總共分成四個部份

基礎學習篇
軟體開發篇
GUI 篇
Brython 篇
「基礎學習篇」著重帶領學習者寫 Python 的小程式，藉此熟悉 Python 的語法，目的不是為了精通 Python 程式語言，而是為了「軟體開發篇」做準備。「軟體開發篇」從軟體規格出發，重點是繼續帶領學習者進一步開發能把英文句子編密碼的 Encrypt 類別。 Encrypt 類別作為「GUI 篇」的計算核心，繼續帶領學習者用 Tk 製作「編密碼小工具」的 GUI 視窗軟體。

-geany-
「Brython 篇」則是藉由第三方程式庫 Brython ，繼續把「邊密碼小工具」移植到網頁上。換言之，「編密碼小工具」就是本 App 依教學需求所開發的產品，這是一個宏觀的角度，先理解軟體的架構，再回推需要補強學習之處，畢竟現在電腦早已不再是先寫編譯器才能讓程式運作，也就是說，目的是讓學習者能先弄懂軟體開發是怎麼一回事，懂了軟體開發，往後再由其他管道，例如 AI 補強語法細節。

現階段 AI 還是一個提示詞給一組回應，當然也可以用如 agent 排程去做，講到提示詞就跟過去指令一樣，換句話說還沒走出自動化程式那一套， Python 就是適合在系統中寫自動化程式工作的程式語言。

有沒有發現一件事情，現在的 AI 是利用自然語言將工作自動化，但是維護能做自動化工作的 agent ，還是需要程式設計師，相對是要求經驗更豐富程式設計師，因此想要當程式設計師，就需要不斷的強化程式設計能力，如果能先弄懂軟體開發是什麼一回事，再來的程式語言的語法細節到電腦底層邏輯，本來很枯燥要死背的東西，一下子就變成有趣了起來。

有趣，學習才有意義，不是嗎？況且要自己手動寫出能跑得程式碼才有成就感，如果像前些日子從網路抄程式碼到現在跟 AI 要程式碼，那其實都不太會產生成就的快感，而且可能需要一直懊惱的除錯，說到這裡，無論網路或 AI 都是寶劍，你手持寶劍是要斬妖除魔，但如果你被寶劍反制控制住你的心靈，寶劍就無法成為你自身力量的延伸，那還不如棄之不用。

最後感謝購買本 App ，但由於每個人的基礎不同，希望本 App 設計的教學方式能對學習程式設計有所幫助。懂不是一件容易的事，但是總是要懂了才知道要怎麼做，做了才會有真正的幫助。

張凱慶 2026/05/13

MUTROPOLIS is a lovely sci-fi adventure set on the abandoned Planet Earth. Play as Henry Dijon (hero, nerd, detective) in search of a legendary lost city. Begin a gorgeous, hand-drawn quest. Uncover weird ancient artifacts. And PLEASE don’t get obliterated by an ageless evil. You’ve been warned.
It is the year 5000, and the greatest achievements in human history are forgotten. The pyramids, the Mona Lisa, The Fresh Prince of Bel Air – forgotten.
Forgotten by everyone except Henry Dijon and his ragtag team of archaeologists. They left Mars to dig up lost treasures on the wild and inhospitable Planet Earth. Life is sweet, until Henry’s professor is kidnapped, and thing start to get... weird.
Join Henry on a freewheeling adventure through the ruins of our civilization. Ask questions like, “Who was this Sony Walkman? And where did he walk?” Unearth extraordinary relics, rescue Professor Totel, and be the first to enter the legendary city of Mutropolis.

Features
• 50+ hand-drawn scenes, crammed with cute, weird characters.
• Full voice over in English, text localizations in Spanish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Russian and Korean.
• Archaeological puzzles with a sci-fi twist.
• TONS OF LOVE!

pt.description:
We’re a small independent group of photographers, designers, and engineers who want more out of their camera: more natural shots, more cinematic video, and more manual controls. We’ve been making MPC-II for over a decade and promise to keep making it better. Join us.

NATURAL, UNPROCESSED SHOTS
It starts with the look.

• MPC-II offers our own Natural Processing imaging pipeline. It builds from RAW data instead of the stock camera’s heavier HDR and contrast, so you get authentic tones without excessive sharpening and noise reduction.
• Dynamic Range Enhancer: a tone mapping pipeline for Natural that recovers detail in highlights and shadows. Set it to Off, Light, Medium, or Strong.
• Import Your LUTs: bring your own into the Look Library and organize them in folders. Shoot with your LUTs baked into your shots, or use them in preview-only mode.

YOUR OWN WORKFLOW
Your camera, your way. We built MPC-II to support anyone’s workflow.

• Swap Your Action Plates: pick the plate that suits you, then choose which controls live on it. Rearrange the controls or remove everything but the capture mode.
• Save Your Profiles: save your capture mode, format, look, and controls. Store unlimited profiles and pin four to quick slots you switch with a tap.
• Launch From Anywhere: open a Profile or capture mode from a widget, a Shortcut, or Apple Watch. On the Watch you also get a live feed, lens switching, Crown zoom, and timers.
• Your Focal Lengths: add the focal lengths you actually shoot to each camera and cycle through them from the lens bar.
• Zen Mode: go distraction-free.

PRO TOOLS
Now for the camera-nerd features. We’ve spent a decade building pro tools that photographers and filmmakers rely on. Missing one? Tell us and we’ll add it.

• All The Manual Controls: Auto, Shutter Priority with ISO range, ISO priority, or full Manual. White balance by temperature and tint, presets, or gray card. Separate exposure and focus reticles, Manual Focus, Focus Peaking, and Focus Loupe. On iPhone 18 Pro, Variable Aperture from f1.48 to f4.0. Works in Photo and Video.
• Photo Modes: Natural, Standard, RAW, or ProRAW. JPG, HEIF, or TIFF. Standard at 12, 24, or 48MP. Shoot 3:4, 4:5, 1:1, or 16:9. Tune ProRAW bit depth and compression.
• Video Modes: Open Gate, Apple Log and Log2, ProRes, 10-bit recording, and HEVC. Set resolution, color space, frame rate, codec, bitrate, and chroma subsampling.
• Slow Shutter: build light trails and motion blur in camera by stacking frames. Set a duration, or hold the exposure open with Bulb.
• Monitoring: Waveform, RGB histograms, zebras, false color, and audio meters. Grids, levels, and social frames.
• Hardware and Storage: save to your photo library, Files, or external storage. Supports external and bluetooth mics, HDMI clean feed, and Moment lenses with anamorphic de-squeeze.

BUILT TO BE RELIED ON
We track our performance closely. Whether you’re shooting from a mountaintop or making a feature film, MPC-II is an app you can count on when it matters most.

• Efficient processing: our pipeline is built to perform, even when shooting high-bandwidth formats with monitors and LUTs.
• Confidence: your selected lens is locked, rather than switching on its own when the light changes. Your format, exposure, and color settings stay on screen, so you always know what you're shooting.
• Always reliable: a stable app you can count on through the whole take, the whole shoot, and the whole trip.

We love hearing from our community. For feature requests, ideas, or support, email us at hello@momentprocamera.com or message us @momentprocamera on social media.

pt.description:
Groundwire: the SIP softphone for your PBX or VoIP provider

Groundwire is a SIP softphone app from Acrobits, a leader in VoIP and communication software since 2009. It delivers clear voice and video calls for personal and professional use, with an interface built for daily calling and none of the clutter.

IMPORTANT, PLEASE READ

Groundwire is a SIP client, not a VoIP service. You need service from a VoIP provider or PBX that supports standard SIP clients.

Business calling features

Groundwire carries the call handling you expect from a desk phone:

- Group calls, for conferencing several people into one conversation.
- Attended transfers, so you can announce a caller before handing the call over.
- Unattended transfers, when the caller just needs the right extension.
- Voicemail with notifications, so a missed call still reaches you.
- Instant messaging, for the things that do not need a call.
- Per-account settings, so one device carries several SIP identities cleanly.

Works with your PBX or VoIP provider

Groundwire is a universal client and true VoIP for PBX users. Teams run it as an Asterisk softphone, a FreePBX extension, or a 3CX endpoint, and it connects just as readily to hosted PBX systems and business phone providers. It also comes preconfigured for major providers, so setup takes minutes. Because it is a standard client, there is no lock-in: bring the account you already have, and Groundwire becomes the mobile extension of your PBX, with encrypted SIP calling on every network.

On a team it is the business softphone dialer sitting on top of the PBX you already pay for. On your own it keeps a work line separate, or carries a desk extension in your pocket.

Key features of the softphone

- Audio on widely used codecs, Opus, G.729 and G.711 among them.
- Video calls at 720p HD, carried by H.264 and VP8.
- Private conversations with military-grade encryption, including TLS, SRTP, and ZRTP.
- Low battery use thanks to efficient push notifications.
- The VoIP dialer hands calls over between WiFi and mobile data without dropping them.
- Custom call settings, UI, and ringtones per account.
- 5G ready and compatible with most mobile operating systems.

A softphone app without the fees

Groundwire is a softphone for calling over WiFi and mobile data, with the business dialer features that usually cost a monthly fee. One payment, no subscription, nothing hidden: buy it once and it stays yours. Encryption sits inside that price rather than on top of it.

Run a call center, manage a fleet of extensions, or keep a dependable sip phone for a home office. The same app covers all of it, without extra tiers.

Download Groundwire and put a dependable SIP dialer on your phone, with Acrobits engineering and responsive support behind it.

Baldur’s Gate II: Enhanced Edition 2.7 patch improves the overall quality-of-life experience, bringing new languages, smoother mobile UI, restored iOS purchase syncing, easier mobile modding & file transferring, and more. The game is now cross-platform compatible for Multiplayer.

Patch Highlights:

New localizations — We added the following community-translated languages to the game: Brazilian Portuguese, Czech, and Ukrainian.
iOS Modding now supported — The game now stores and reads data from a location visible to standard file browsers. You can manage saves and other files directly on your device or by connecting it to a computer:
On iOS: Open the Files app → navigate to On My device → find the game’s folder;
The home:/ directory is now user-accessible;
You can transfer saves, character portraits, and other files (mods) between different devices.
Mobile Keyboard Improvements — The UI now shifts so the text cursor remains visible above the virtual keyboard, preventing cursor loss and mis‑registered taps on iOS.
Dynamic language support — We made changes to allow easier language updates and additions in the future.
Chinese font change — At the request of the Chinese localization volunteers, we have changed the font for Chinese.
Font Size saved per font language — The Font Size zoom setting is now saved per font language.
Indexing Fix — Resolved an off‑by‑one error in rebuilt BIF files that affected some community tools.

Kidnapped. Imprisoned. Tortured. The wizard Irenicus holds you captive in his stronghold, attempting to strip you of the powers that are your birthright.
As you escape and step back into the wider world, the question at the heart of the Bhaalspawn saga becomes impossible to ignore. Can you resist the evil in your blood and forsake the dark destiny that awaits you? Or will you embrace your monstrous nature within and ascend to godhood as the new Lord of Murder?

Baldur’s Gate II: Enhanced Edition brings one of the most celebrated RPGs of all time back for modern adventurers, preserving the depth, atmosphere, and storytelling that defined the golden age of cRPGs.
Continue the journey you began in Baldur’s Gate: Enhanced Edition, carrying your hero forward into a darker, more ambitious chapter—or forge a new protagonist to shape your own path through the Forgotten Realms.

The Enhanced Edition includes the full original experience—Shadows of Amn and Throne of Bhaal—along with a refined arena mode for players who enjoy tactical challenges.
Classic Campaign: The original Shadows of Amn adventure, faithfully restored
Expansion: Throne of Bhaal, the epic conclusion to the Bhaalspawn saga
Arena Challenges: The Black Pits II: Gladiators of Thay, a gauntlet of strategic battles
Refined Difficulty Options: Story Mode for relaxed exploration and narrative focus; Legacy of Bhaal for veterans seeking a punishing, old‑school test of skill
Fist of the Fallen: Help Rasaad, the Sun Soul Monk, find peace in his quest for vengeance.

The following content is available for in-app purchase:

- A Price Paid in Blood: Help the Blackguard Dorn Il-Khan appease the bloody demands of his dark patron.
- A Voice in the Dark: Recruit the Thief Hexxat and retrieve long-lost artifacts from tombs as far away as Zakhara.
- In Defense of the Wild: Stand with Neera the Wild Mage against a ruthless school of Red Wizards.

The classic returns with thoughtful refinements that make it smoother to play today while keeping its soul untouched.

Note: All translations are text only. Voice-overs are played in English.

Skul é um roguelite de ação em ritmo acelerado, onde incentiva-se a perder a cabeça.

Com 100 personagens jogáveis, cada um com as próprias habilidades exclusivas e muitos itens que podem criar sinergias incríveis, as batalhas são tão eletrizantes quanto desafiadoras.

O Castelo do Rei Demônio em ruínas
O ataque da raça humana ao castelo do Rei Demônio não é novidade e já aconteceu inúmeras vezes.
Desta vez, o que difere é que os aventureiros decidiram unir forças com o Exército Imperial e escolheram o “Herói de Caerleon” para liderar um ataque total na esperança de exterminar os demônios de uma vez por todas.
Eles atacaram a fortaleza do Demônio com números esmagadores e conseguiram destruí-lo totalmente. Todos os demônios do castelo viraram prisioneiros, exceto um esqueleto solitário chamado “Skul”.

Modo Espelho Sombrio
Ao terminar a história principal, teste suas habilidades e seus limites no novo e desafiador modo “Espelho Sombrio”!

CARACTERÍSTICAS
- Você é a última esperança de toda a raça demoníaca! Jogue como Skul, um esqueletinho no caminho para matar os heróis pomposos e salvar o rei demônio do exército corrupto de Caerleon.
- Perder a cabeça nunca foi tão certo: experimente crânios novos para pegar emprestado os poderes e as roupas elegantes dos donos anteriores e crie sinergias com itens exclusivos para derrotar os inimigos.

pt.description:
PARTICIPE DA BATALHA.
Jogue o jogo clássico de estratégia da Hasbro — Axis & Allies 1942, 2ª edição — no iPad! Este jogo de tabuleiro cabe nas mãos e na agenda ocupada. Receba uma notificação quando chegar a sua vez e comande os exércitos quando quiser!

Jogue com amigos em qualquer plataforma, desafie os melhores jogadores de Axis & Allies em temporadas ranqueadas, jogue sozinho contra a máquina ou compartilhe um tablet para jogar com amigos presencialmente!

RECURSOS

Regras oficiais 
- Adaptação das regras do jogo Axis & Allies 1942, 2ª edição, da Hasbro
- Escolha entre dois cenários de jogo e condições de vitória!
- Aliados: comande as forças do Reino Unido, dos Estados Unidos ou da União Soviética
- Eixo: assuma o controle dos exércitos da Alemanha ou do Japão e parta para a guerra.

Aprender a jogar 
- Excelente para novos jogadores — não é necessário preparar nem organizar!
- Tutoriais e dicas dentro do próprio jogo ensinam tudo o que iniciantes precisam saber

Jogo em turnos (assíncrono)
- Jogabilidade em turnos para acomodar agendas ocupadas! 
- Jogos ranqueados concedem 24 horas para o jogador terminar o turno.
- Receba uma notificação quando seu turno chegar e use o diário de guerra para verificar as atuações alheias em vez de jogar horas a fio — ou assista às batalhas em tempo real!

Contas e perfis de jogador
- Rastreie seus atributos e suas taxas de vitória e derrota para cada aliança
- A conta do comandante pode sincronizar com mais de um dispositivo
- Varie entre um iPad e um computador para atuar em seus turnos, visualizar suas estatísticas e conectar-se com amigos

Modos de dados
- O modo padrão imita resultados aleatórios de dados
- O modo de menos variabilidade calcula a média dos números
- O modo tendencioso favorece rolagens de 2, 3 e 4 e desfavorece 1 e 6.

Jogabilidade imersiva
- Gráficos, música e efeitos sonoros de alta qualidade dão um ar dramático aos combates!

MODOS DE JOGO

Individual
- Jogue casualmente contra a máquina
- Excelente método para testar estratégias ou aprender a jogar

Compartilhado
- Compartilhe o tablet com amigos e familiares

Multijogador on-line
- Compatibiliza jogadores entre plataformas — tablets e computadores
- Crie jogos personalizados para 2 a 5 jogadores
- Os jogos podem incluir uma mistura entre jogadores e IA

Temporadas ranqueadas
- Desafie os melhores jogadores de Axis & Allies nas temporadas ranqueadas oficiais
- Ganhe pontos para melhorar sua classificação e chegar ao topo: classificações Madeira, Bronze, Prata, Ouro e Platina!
- O sistema de mediação organiza partidas entre jogadores de classificações semelhantes

É A PRIMAVERA DE 1942... O MUNDO ESTÁ EM GUERRA
Tanques alemães se mobilizam a oeste para atravessar o território francês e forçar a União Soviética a se retirar para o leste europeu. Os Estados Unidos respondem à agressão japonesa no Pacífico. O Reino Unido reúne aliados perante as ameaças de bombardeios aéreos. O ano é 1942 e o mundo está em guerra! 

A vitória será das forças que conquistarem os adversários em campo de batalha e ocuparem algumas das cidades mais importantes do mundo. Conseguirá o Eixo continuar a se espalhar pelo planeta ou os Aliados serão capazes de conter a tirania imperialista? Desafie seus amigos e mude o curso da história!

pt.description:
Moncage is a stunning vignette puzzle adventure developed by Optillusion. 

The game takes place inside a mysterious cube, with each side of the cube housing a unique world: be it an old factory, a light tower, an amusement park, or a church, etc. At first sight, they may seem random and unrelated, but upon closer look, you will become mesmerized by the subtle and intricate ways of how these worlds connect…  

【Solve Puzzles with Mind-Boggling Optical Illusions】
Use your imagination and spare no brain cells to find the connection and pinpoint every possible interaction between different sides of the cube, then watch as the magic unfold in front of you.

【Collect All Photos to Unveil the Story】
Behind the puzzles, there lies a story with a surprising twist for the player to uncover. Collect the photos from obscure corners and angles to reveal the underlying story, one photo at a time.

【Get Unstuck with Thoughtful Hints】
There is a multitude of guidance systems to help prevent players from getting stuck. Focus can be activated to highlight the key items to the solution, while hint texts are available to provide further clarity. And, if all else fails, video walkthroughs can be unlocked as the ultimate safety plan. 

【Prove Your Puzzle-Solving Skills with Medals】
There are a total of 15 achievements in the game, each corresponding with a Medal that has been crafted with a uniquely stunning design. A complete collection of the 15 Medals could be the perfect evidence to attest to your master puzzle-solving skills~

pt.description:
Where you're born decides more about your life than almost anything you'll ever choose. 1in8b Life lets you feel that.

Press "Be born" and a point skips across the world map until it settles on one place: a city in Nigeria, a village in India, an apartment in Seoul, a farm in Bolivia. The odds are real. Countries with more babies come up more often, just as they do in life.

Then you live. Year by year, from your first word to your last breath.

A WHOLE LIFE, IN REAL NUMBERS
Your chances of surviving childhood, going to school, finding work, earning a living and growing old come from real data for 172 countries and territories. That data covers life expectancy, child mortality, income and inequality, schooling, fertility, health costs, conflict, natural hazards and more.

YOUR CHOICES STILL MATTER
Each year you decide where to spend your free time: study, career, family, health, faith, rest. You'll face hundreds of decisions: stay in school or help your family, move to the city, marry, have children, buy a home, invest, lend a friend money, flee a war, fight an illness. Every option shows its cost, its chances and its trade-offs. Effort counts, but circumstance pushes back.

THE PEOPLE AROUND YOU
Parents with names and jobs, brothers and sisters, a spouse, children and grandchildren, friends, pets. They grow up, grow old, move away and pass on. Your identity card, family panel and wealth breakdown show your whole life at a glance.

BORN IN THE SAME SECOND
Three other babies are born at the very moment you are, somewhere else in the world. Their lives unfold by the same rules. You'll hear how they go.

A LIFE RECORD TO KEEP
When your life ends, you get its full story: the turning points, the people, the numbers, how you compared with the rest of the world. Every life becomes a star in your sky of past lives. Share any of them as an image.

FEATURES
• 172 countries and territories, weighted by real birth rates
• Hundreds of events and decisions, with real odds shown
• Careers, school, marriage, children, migration, illness, war, recessions and inflation
• A pixel-art scene of your home and family that changes as you age
• Pauses at 5, 18, 30, 50 and 70 to reflect, and write down your thoughts
• Works offline. No account, no sign-up; your lives stay on your device

These lives are simulations, not predictions. They show the odds people face, not anyone's fate. Each one is a reminder of how much of a life is decided before it begins.


Where will you be born?

pt.releaseNotes: Cada vez mais conteúdo para o Digline! Diz-se que, para lá da casa do teu vizinho, à esquerda, chegou uma nova personagem misteriosa. E traz montes de experiências para testares na tua broca. Pelo menos algumas devem funcionar... talvez.
pt.description:
Digline é um jogo de perfuração relaxante e fácil de aprender, onde cada descida é uma pequena aposta entre progresso e risco, e a verdadeira recompensa está mais fundo no subsolo.

Comece cada partida na sua oficina, escolha sua configuração e desça com combustível limitado e um equipamento improvisado. Abra caminho através de camadas de terra em constante mudança, decida o que coletar e escolha o momento certo para voltar antes que tudo se esgote.

Cada descida revela novos materiais, descobertas mais raras e padrões inesperados sob a superfície. O que começa como uma simples escavação gradualmente se transforma em um equilíbrio cuidadoso entre exploração, eficiência e tempo.

De volta à superfície, refine sua estratégia e melhore suas partidas:

• Melhore sua perfuradora, capacidade de combustível e eficiência
• Desbloqueie novos materiais de maior valor e localizados mais profundamente
• Otimize rotas para maximizar cada descida

O progresso se acumula de forma constante, mas cada partida carrega tensão. Se jogar com muita cautela, você deixa valor para trás. Se avançar demais, corre o risco de perder tudo.

Defina seu próprio ritmo no subsolo: partidas curtas e eficientes, descidas profundas de alto risco ou uma progressão constante rumo ao domínio do que está abaixo.

Top 10 jogos casuais nos Estados Unidos e no Reino Unido, Top 5 na Alemanha, Noruega e outros. Venha se juntar à diversão!

O que começa como uma simples busca por recursos gradualmente se torna algo mais estranho. Seus antigos túneis permanecem, seu mapa se expande com o tempo, e o subsolo passa a parecer menos aleatório e mais como um lugar com sua própria história.

Digline foi projetado para ser fácil de começar, divertido em sessões curtas e recompensador no longo prazo. Escavações rápidas, descidas curtas, muita diversão relaxante.

Recursos:

• controles intuitivos com um dedo em modo retrato
• partidas curtas que cabem facilmente em um ou dois minutos
• túneis persistentes e um mapa que cresce a cada expedição
• múltiplas regiões subterrâneas com diferentes materiais, perigos e surpresas
• recursos para coletar e usar na criação de melhorias e melhor preparação
• uma oficina que transforma cada partida bem-sucedida em progresso permanente
• um sistema de mercado para negociar o que você traz de volta
• progressão que se constrói ao longo de muitas sessões, não apenas uma única partida
• uma atmosfera calma e aconchegante com um senso de descoberta por baixo
• sem anúncios, sem compras dentro do aplicativo e sem sistemas pay-to-win
• conquistas e competição no placar do Daily Dig

Quanto mais fundo você vai, mais a mina revela.

Uma versão 2D remodelada do quarto jogo da grandiosa série FINAL FANTASY! Aproveite a clássica história contada com um nostálgico visual retrô. Toda a magia do original, agora mais acessível.

O rei de Baron enviou sua força aérea de elite, os Asas Vermelhas, para atacar os reinos vizinhos. Cecil, um cavaleiro das trevas e capitão dos Asas Vermelhas, fica angustiado com a missão e decide enfrentar a tirania de Baron ao lado de seu leal amigo e de sua amada. Cecil viajará pela terra, pelo subterrâneo, à Terra dos Eidolons, e até mesmo à lua em busca dos cristais. Junte-se ao cavaleiro-dragão Kain, à maga branca Rosa, à invocadora Rydia e a vários outros aliados habilidosos.

FFIV é o primeiro da série a introduzir o dinâmico sistema de Batalha de Tempo Ativo, no qual o tempo não para mesmo durante o combate e dá aos jogadores a eletrizante sensação de urgência. Devido ao grande sucesso do jogo, este revolucionário sistema foi implementado em vários títulos subsequentes da série.

Não perca a dramática história e as batalhas dinâmicas do quarto jogo da série FINAL FANTASY!

---------------------------------------------

■ Lindamente reanimados com novos gráficos e sons!
・Gráficos pixelados 2D totalmente atualizados, incluindo os icônicos designs em pixel dos personagens de FINAL FANTASY criados por Kazuko Shibuya, o artista original e atual colaborador.
・Trilha sonora com novos arranjos belíssimos, fieis ao estilo de FINAL FANTASY, supervisionada pelo compositor original, Nobuo Uematsu.

■ Melhor jogabilidade!
・Inclui IU modernizada, opções de batalha automática e mais.
・Compatível com o uso de controles, incluindo uma interface dedicada para conectar um controle ao dispositivo.
・Alterne a trilha sonora entre a versão rearranjada, criada para a versão pixel remasterizada, e a versão original, que captura o som do jogo original.
・Agora é possível alternar entre diferentes fontes, incluindo a fonte padrão e uma fonte de pixel condizente com a atmosfera do jogo original.
・Com recursos aprimorados para expandir as opções de jogabilidade, incluindo a desativação de encontros aleatórios e ajuste de multiplicadores de experiência obtida entre 0 e 4.
・Mergulhe no mundo do jogo com extras complementares, como bestiário, galeria de ilustrações e reprodutor de música.

*Compra única. Não há pagamentos adicionais ao longo do jogo após a compra inicial e o subsequente download.
*Esta versão remaster se baseia no jogo "FINAL FANTASY IV" original lançado em 1991. Alguns recursos e/ou parte do conteúdo podem ser diferentes de versões relançadas anteriormente.

iOS 13.0 ou superior

[Dispositivos aplicáveis]
iPhone 7 Plus, iPad (7ª geração), iPad Air (3ª geração), iPad mini (5ª geração) e posteriores

Outline

The smash hit RPG: Final Fantasy VII, which has sold over 11,000,000 units* worldwide, finally arrives on iOS!
*Total includes both packaged sales and downloads.

The first Final Fantasy to feature 3D backgrounds and CG movie scenes, this dramatic tale continues to be loved by numerous fans around the world. Battle stages also appear in full 3D for the first time, bringing an even greater sense of awe and spectacle to combat!

Customize your characters in any way you like using the fantastic “material” system that allows endless combinations of spells and abilities.

This product is a port based on Final Fantasy VII for PC (No changes or additions have been made to the story). 


Story

With its unshakeable monopoly over Mako energy production, the evil Shinra Electric Power Company holds tight to the reigns of world power.
One day, a Mako reactor serving the sprawling metropolis of Midgar is attacked and destroyed in a bombing raid by a revolutionary group calling themselves Avalanche. 
Cloud Strife, a former member of Shinra’s elite “Soldier” unit takes part in the raid as a mercenary hired by Avalanche and sets events in motion that will draw him and his friends into an epic struggle for the fate of the planet itself…


Special features for the iOS edition 

- Play using a simple and comfortable virtual controller designed not to obscure the action, choosing between virtual analogue or fixed 4-way digital control pad options. The opacity of on-screen controls can also be adjusted from the Config Menu.

- Two new features to make play easier and more convenient!
The iOS edition also includes an option to turn enemy encounters off on the world and area maps (will not skip event battles) and a Max Stats command to become all-powerful in the blink of an eye.


Major game controls

Movement: Virtual joypad (Select between analogue and digital modes)
Menu navigation: Fixed digital buttons
Confirm: A button
Cancel: B button
Open menu: Y button

・ This application requires approximately 2.55GB to download. Please be sure to allocate the necessary amount of time and space on your device before proceeding.
・ Only one download with a large amount of data will be required while progressing through the game.

------------------------------

[Please read before playing]

* Entering or leaving vehicles such as cars and the Garden may occasionally get your character stuck between the vehicle and terrain features, or freeze the vehicle in place. This seems to happen more often when you leave your vehicle in close proximity to impassable terrain, or when you try to enter or leave your vehicle during certain scripted events. Currently, the only fix for this is to reload a previously saved game, so please make sure to save your progress often.

* Some locations may be difficult to navigate using the Speed Boost (x3). We advise you to turn off this feature in such cases.

* Make sure to check the FAQ section of our support page for solutions to common issues:
https://support.na.square-enix.com/main.php?la=1&id=442

We apologize for any inconvenience these issues may cause, and thank you again for your interest in our product.

■Summary
FINAL FANTASY VIII was first released on February 11, 1999. Beloved by fans, this title has garnered a great deal of popularity even compared to other installments in the FINAL FANTASY franchise, selling more than 9.6 million units worldwide. And now players can enjoy FINAL FANTASY VIII on their smartphone! With renewed character CG, the world of FINAL FANTASY VIII is now more beautiful than ever before.

This installment is a remaster of FINAL FANTASY VIII for PC. This application is a one-time purchase. There will be no additional charge incurred after downloading.

■Story
It is a time of war.
The Republic of Galbadia, under the influence of the sorceress Edea, mobilizes its great armies against the other nations of the world.
Squall and other members of SeeD, an elite mercenary force, join hands with Rinoa, a resistance fighter, to fight against Galbadia's tyrannical rule and to prevent Edea from fulfilling her ultimate goal.

■FINAL FANTASY VIII: Release Features
・Guardian Force（G.F.）
G.F. are summoned creatures in FFVIII used to protect the protagonists. Call upon them in battle to unleash their might and to increase their power alongside player characters. By junctioning G.F., players will be able to enjoy greater freedom in how they approach battles.

・Drawing
Obtain magic in FFVIII by drawing (extracting) it in battle. MP does not exist and players are limited to the number they have in their possession. Magic that has been extracted can be released on the spot or stocked for later use.

・ Junctioning
This system allows players to equip G.F. and stocked magic to characters in order to increase their power.

■ Additional Features
・ Battle Assist
Max out HP and ATB gauge during battle and activate Limit Breaks at any time.
・ No Encounters
Players can choose to turn Battle Encounters on or off.
・ 3x Speed
With the exception of certain cutscenes, players can choose to proceed through the game at 3x speed.

iOS 15.0 or higher

般若心灯是一款佛教经典导读、念佛计数与佛乐聆听应用，帮助您随时随地诵读经文、聆听梵音、记录功课，在日常中安住身心、亲近佛法。

    【经书收录】
    收录心经、金刚经、普门品、药师经、普光明藏经、阿弥陀经、法华经、六祖坛经、楞严经、地藏经等经典，大悲咒、楞严咒、准提咒、百字明咒、往生咒、绿度母心咒等咒语真言，以及大忏悔文、回向文、课诵仪轨、药师经仪轨、地藏经
  前仪等课诵内容，共二十四部经典与仪轨，持续更新中。

    【课诵仪轨】
    香赞、净口业与净三业真言、安土地真言、普供养真言、开经偈为前行，补阙真言、普回向真言、三皈依为结行，诵持任一经典皆可依用；另立药师专篇，收药师赞、药师偈与药师灌顶真言。

    【逐字拼音】
    每一个汉字上方都标注了准确的拼音，方便初学者正确诵读经文，不再因生僻字而困扰。

    【白话文解释】
    关键经文配有通俗易懂的白话文解释，轻触即可查看，帮助您深入理解经文含义。

    【经文朗读】
    部分经典内置音频朗读，支持进度拖动、0.25x 至 2.0x 变速播放，以及后台与锁屏播放；未配音的经典仍可使用逐字拼音安心诵读。

    【歌词式阅读指示】
    阅读经文时，屏幕中央显示虚线定位指示器与当前行号，当前行高亮、远处渐淡，方便随时找回诵读位置。

    【佛乐聆听】
    精选 34 首佛教音乐，涵盖大悲咒、密咒真言、凡歌咏法、一心念佛等八大分类，支持播放列表、上下曲切换、进度拖动与变速播放，后台锁屏亦可聆听。可设 10 至 90 分钟定时关闭或「播完本曲」，到点前音量渐渐淡出，不会突然静下
  来。

    【佛珠念佛】
    轻触或沿珠串滑动即可拨珠计数，每颗都有木珠相碰的音效与触感反馈，108 颗圆满一圈。本次声数叠在佛珠环心，今日与本圈进度并列其下；长按佛珠可按本次、今日、累计分别归零。圣号可下拉切换或自行添加，拨珠音色可选佛珠或木
  鱼，振动强度分轻、中、强三档。自动记录今日声数与念佛时长，可一键生成水墨风格卡片分享今日修持。

    【自定义功课】
    可新建功课，设定名称、圣号、总目标与目标天数，每天该念多少自动算出。念佛页显示目标进度、剩余声数与今日完成情况，每份功课可单独设定回向文，发愿时自动填入；达成每日目标或圆满总目标时给出提示。

    【佛历】
    二十七个佛菩萨圣诞与初一、十五集中一页，按农历月分组，农历与公历对照，只列当年剩余的日子。可开启提醒，于前一日傍晚收到通知，斋日提醒可单独开关。

    【修行打卡】
    每日打卡记录修行，日历视图直观展示诵经轨迹，连续天数激励您坚持修行。偶尔忘记打卡也无妨，支持补打最近数日的功课，连续天数自动接上。

    【功德牌与足迹】
    诵读、打卡、念佛皆可累积功德牌，涵盖单经精进、广学多闻、持之以恒、念佛功课与佛菩萨圣诞时节。轻触日历上的打卡点，可回看那一天诵读过哪些经书，并为当日功课写下心愿。

    【发愿回向】
    念佛之后可写下愿文与回向，一日多愿亦可分别留档。所有发愿按时间成串收在「发愿记录」中，可随时修改或删除，日后回看重温初心。

    【修行回顾】
    按年汇总修行天数、最长连续与常诵经典，生成水墨风格回顾卡片，可保存分享。

    【iCloud 同步】
    开启后，打卡记录、功德牌、诵经进度、自定义功课与圣号在您的各台设备间保持一致，无需额外费用。

    【个性设置】
    支持夜间模式，经文字号自由调节，打造舒适的阅读体验。

    【收藏与进度】
    收藏常读经书，自动记录阅读进度，每次打开都能继续上次的修行。

    般若心灯，愿以智慧之光，照亮您的修行之路。

    【随喜护持】
    佛经、佛咒与仪轨全部免费诵读。念佛计数、佛乐聆听与离线下载、修行记录与打卡、自定义背景与佛像、经文听诵、自定义功课、年度回顾为护持功能，可选月度护持、年度护持（自动续订，可随时在 Apple ID 设置中取消）或终身护持（一次性购买）。付费下载时期已购买的用户自动视为终身护持。

pt.description:
AI 時代還要學程式設計嗎？事實是要，但已經不是過去的學習方式，怎麼說呢？以前的老前輩總是要學初學者先掌握一門程式語言，這裡所謂的掌握，拿 C 語言來舉例，就是要到能開發出 C 語言編譯器甚至到用 C 語言寫出作業系統，所以程式設計專科像是資訊工程系的課程就是這樣安排。

換句話說，過去的觀念強調用背誦培養，不管學生懂不懂，反正學生不懂也是可以先背起來，很多前輩的求學歷程不外都是先背了一堆知識，等到了未來某一天見到了某個知識點，才總算觸類旁通，以前不懂的，才在突然懂了，也就是到了特定知識點才對程式設計開竅。

先記住等到以後才弄懂的模式，坦白說是要在戰後快速培養人才，這樣記性好、學習效率高，也就是遴選出智商高的人才，問題是記性不等於悟性，所以記住是記住，卻不等於理解到懂的程度。

這就導致一種很詭異的現象，智商高的人記住了但是不懂，結果就是一直耍小聰明，賣弄他記住的知識，卻難以真正做創造或發明的工作，其實現在的 AI 幾乎可以說是就是智商極高的智能體， AI 可以依據提示詞做推論，但也僅只於推論而已，正確與否或是否符合需求則需要由另一套機制驗證。

所以 AI 強在可以跟你講知識，依據你輸入的文字推論你想要的結果，但目前的 AI 無法體察你言語間細微的變化，也無法分辨你言語的意思是否是 AI 能夠理解的意思，換句話說沒辦法察言觀色，也就是 AI 理解不了你懂或是不懂，或是你的理解與 AI 的理解是否相同，結果是你讓智商高的 AI 一直賣弄小聰明，向你堆知識，瞬間給你座圖書館，這就引出真正的難題，你不懂就不會用，你能做的頂多是跟 AI 一樣，依樣畫葫蘆，如果你不想畫一樣的葫蘆，你還是得懂。

正因為是弄懂了才會用，從另一種角度來講，懂了才知道要去記什麼，從而長出記性，多年的教學經驗給我的感受是讓多數學習程式設計的人，恍然大悟的知識點是弄懂產品的概念，換言之，從前是先學什麼是程式，從程式慢慢擴張到軟體，再從軟體的角度去學開發產品，這時候軟體規格到整個軟體的架構才出來，然後才懂得程式只是零件，所以說到頭，軟體開發是有了基本的邏輯概念後，去寫構成零件的程式，然後才能去組合零件到產品。

所以本 App 的設計理念反其道而行，從產品的角度出發，總共分成四個部份

基礎學習篇
軟體開發篇
GUI 篇
Brython 篇
「基礎學習篇」著重帶領學習者寫 Python 的小程式，藉此熟悉 Python 的語法，目的不是為了精通 Python 程式語言，而是為了「軟體開發篇」做準備。「軟體開發篇」從軟體規格出發，重點是繼續帶領學習者進一步開發能把英文句子編密碼的 Encrypt 類別。 Encrypt 類別作為「GUI 篇」的計算核心，繼續帶領學習者用 Tk 製作「編密碼小工具」的 GUI 視窗軟體。

-geany-
「Brython 篇」則是藉由第三方程式庫 Brython ，繼續把「邊密碼小工具」移植到網頁上。換言之，「編密碼小工具」就是本 App 依教學需求所開發的產品，這是一個宏觀的角度，先理解軟體的架構，再回推需要補強學習之處，畢竟現在電腦早已不再是先寫編譯器才能讓程式運作，也就是說，目的是讓學習者能先弄懂軟體開發是怎麼一回事，懂了軟體開發，往後再由其他管道，例如 AI 補強語法細節。

現階段 AI 還是一個提示詞給一組回應，當然也可以用如 agent 排程去做，講到提示詞就跟過去指令一樣，換句話說還沒走出自動化程式那一套， Python 就是適合在系統中寫自動化程式工作的程式語言。

有沒有發現一件事情，現在的 AI 是利用自然語言將工作自動化，但是維護能做自動化工作的 agent ，還是需要程式設計師，相對是要求經驗更豐富程式設計師，因此想要當程式設計師，就需要不斷的強化程式設計能力，如果能先弄懂軟體開發是什麼一回事，再來的程式語言的語法細節到電腦底層邏輯，本來很枯燥要死背的東西，一下子就變成有趣了起來。

有趣，學習才有意義，不是嗎？況且要自己手動寫出能跑得程式碼才有成就感，如果像前些日子從網路抄程式碼到現在跟 AI 要程式碼，那其實都不太會產生成就的快感，而且可能需要一直懊惱的除錯，說到這裡，無論網路或 AI 都是寶劍，你手持寶劍是要斬妖除魔，但如果你被寶劍反制控制住你的心靈，寶劍就無法成為你自身力量的延伸，那還不如棄之不用。

最後感謝購買本 App ，但由於每個人的基礎不同，希望本 App 設計的教學方式能對學習程式設計有所幫助。懂不是一件容易的事，但是總是要懂了才知道要怎麼做，做了才會有真正的幫助。

張凱慶 2026/05/13

pt.description:
MUTROPOLIS é uma adorável aventura sci-fi que se passa em um Planeta Terra abandonado. Jogue como Henry Dijon (herói, nerd, detetive) em busca de uma lendária cidade perdida. Inicie uma bela jornada desenhada à mão e descubra estranhos artefatos antigos. E POR FAVOR, não seja obliterado por um perpétuo mal. Você foi avisado.
É o ano 5000 e as maiores conquistas da humanidade foram perdidas. As pirâmides, a Mona Lisa e Um Maluco no Pedaço foram totalmente esquecidos.
Esquecidos por todos exceto Henry Dijon e sua maluca equipe de arqueológos. Eles saíram de Marte para escavar tesouros perdidos no selvagem e inabitável Planeta Terra. Tudo corre bem até o professor de Henry ser raptado e as coisas começarem a ficar… esquisitas.
Junte-se a Henry em uma aventura através das ruínas de nossa civilização. Faça perguntas como "Quem foi Sony Walkman? Por onde ele andava?" Descubra relíquias extraordinárias, resgate o Professor Totel e seja o primeiro a entrar na lendária cidade de Mutropolis.
Mais uma coisa - os deuses do antigo Egito são reais e estão tentando destruir a humanidade. - Divirta-se!

Características
• 50+ cenas desenhadas à mão repletas de personagens esquisitos e adoráveis.
• Dublagem completa em inglês e textos em espanhol, alemão, francês, italiano, português, russo e coreano.
• Puzzles arqueológicos com uma pegada sci-fi.
• MUITO AMOR!
